Roast chicken. Remove wish bone while raw. Separate skin from breast with fingers to make pockets. Place pads of butter under skin, on top of breasts. Season bird (salt and pepper). Lay raw bacon strips on top of chicken breasts. Place a lemon, whole, inside chicken. Place bird in deep roasting dish. Oven.

Once bacon is crispy, remove from bird. When bird is 3/4 done pour pan drippings into a pot. Smash up the bacon into pan drippings. Add a few chopped tomatoes (this helps to naturally thicken gravy) and a sprig of rosemary. Simmer, simmer, simmer. Not boiling away like a witches brew. Simmer that shit. Whisk and stir. Reduce volume to concentrate flavor and remove water. A good rule of thumb for sauces and gravies is that it must coat a spoon. Pull that lemon out of the bird and juice into gravy. Fat is flavor but acid is life. Run it through a sieve and into your gravy bowl.

By now the bird is done. Let it rest. Do not stick a knife in it. Let the juices naturally recede back into the meat. 15 minutes. If the bird cooked up faster than you thought use the resting time to make gravy.

Serve that with rutabaga and a salad. Or in another roasting pan do some oven roasted veg with butter and lemon, that's practically hands free.
